hook: Claude ported Rockbox to a nine-dollar MP3 player.

beats.say: The player is an unbranded nine-dollar MP3 player from AliExpress, with just 512 kilobytes of memory and no documentation. The author paid nine dollars and seventy-one cents, shipped.
With the help of large language models, Rockbox now runs on it, and the author says he was barely involved. The port produced a reusable toolkit for future ports.
To prove the toolkit works, Claude ported Rockbox to a second player, the TS47, in four hours.
